note: Full precision-recall curves per hazard class, built from ONE low-confidence (conf=0.01) capture via cumulative confidence-descending IoU>=0.5 matching (benchmark/metrics.py). Sample-size context: Person=303 GT boxes, Car=148 GT boxes, Bicycle=78 GT boxes, Dog=52 GT boxes, Motorcycle=49 GT boxes, Bus=49 GT boxes, Stairs=45 GT boxes, Truck=42 GT boxes. Classes with under ~50 GT boxes (Stairs, Motorcycle, Bus, Dog) should be read as low-confidence curves — a handful of boxes changes them a lot.
